rules.title: A board divided by water
rules.description: Seven files cross three lands and a central river. Every animal has its own way through.

goal.title: The goal
goal.body: Capture the opposing Lion to win immediately. A player with no legal move loses.

lion.title: The Lion
lion.body: It moves one square inside its own castle. It leaves only to capture the opposing Lion along a clear file or diagonal. Lions may enter attacked squares; there is no check.

monkey.title: The Monkey
monkey.body: It steps without capturing, or jumps an adjacent enemy to capture. Several jumps form one optional route; captured pieces stay as blockers until the route ends.

river.title: The river
river.body: A non-Crocodile in the river must leave on its next own turn or drown. The Crocodile is immune. The Lion cannot enter the river.

pawn.title: Pawn and Superpawn
pawn.body: A Pawn moves forward and captures diagonally. On the far bank it may retreat one or two squares. It promotes automatically on the last rank; a Superpawn gains sideways movement and retreats anywhere.
